name: Sharafudheen
bio: Sharafudheen is a Malayalam film actor who made his acting debut in the 2013 movie, Neram. He got his breakthrough by portraying the role of Girirajan Kozhi in Premam (2015).

credits.title: It's a Medical Miracle
credits.overview: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

credits.title: Mollywood Times
credits.overview: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

credits.title: Madhuvidhu
credits.overview: When Amrutharaj, a groom from an all-male household repeatedly rejected by brides' families, falls in love with Sneha Marcose, their journey toward marriage ignites a chain of hilarious chaos inside his unruly home.

credits.title: Prathichaya
credits.overview: After Kerala’s Chief Minister dies in a scandal engineered by a ruthless media tycoon, his son a brilliant tech entrepreneur enters the blood-soaked arena of politics to expose the conspiracy, vindicate his father, and turn technology against those who weaponized it

credits.title: Ashakal Aayiram
credits.overview: A social media enthusiast chases fame until a major film production arrives in his neighborhood, suddenly bringing his dreams of stardom within reach in ways he never imagined.

credits.title: Khajuraho Dreams
credits.overview: A group of friends set out on an impulsive journey to explore Khajuraho. Later, their original intent changes as tourists, as they come across helpless villagers of the district.

credits.title: The Pet Detective
credits.overview: A couple of amateur sleuths attempt to solve the mystery behind disappearing pets, but become embroiled in far more sinister crimes.

credits.title: Samshayam
credits.overview: One day, Vimala develops an unshakeable suspicion. Her husband Manojan's search for answers to her doubt leads him on a journey that could destroy everything he knows.

credits.title: Padakkalam
credits.overview: Four nerdy comic book enthusiasts find themselves in an unexpected adventure when their school's charming new professor turns their academic world upside down with supernatural events.

credits.title: Sorgavaasal
credits.overview: A common man imprisoned in a corrupt system questions whether jails truly rehabilitate or push individuals deeper into crime's abyss.

credits.title: Hello Mummy
credits.overview: Boney, a carefree man finds his life turned upside down after marriage when hes forced to deal with the restless spirit of his obsessive-compulsive mother-in-law.

credits.title: Bougainvillea
credits.overview: A family entangled in a police investigation surrounding the mysterious disappearance of tourists in Kerala.

credits.title: Level Cross
credits.overview: In a desolate desert, a reclusive gatekeeper offers refuge to a mysterious woman fleeing a dark past, leading to an unraveling of secrets and shattered realities.

credits.title: Tholvi F.C.
credits.overview: Life turns topsy turvy for the Kuruvila family when each of them face failures in their lives. Will they overcome it or will they go into disarray?

credits.title: Madhura Manohara Moham
credits.overview: Town of Kumbazha, the lives of Manu and Meera's family are forever altered by an unexpected truth. As the unshakeable foundation crumbles, they embark on a tumultuous journey, challenging societal norms.

credits.title: Janaki Jaane
credits.overview: Struggling with panic disorder, Janaki is ecstatic when Unni Mukundan proposes to marry her. Things go south when Janaki's fears land her in serious trouble.

credits.title: Ntikkakkakkoru Premondarnn
credits.overview: Story of estranged teenage lovers, Jimmy and Nithya. Set in the backdrop of the coastal region, Jimmy belongs to a middle-class muslim family while Nithya is a Hindu girl. They meet years later.

credits.title: Djinn
credits.overview: Lalappan is empathetic, compassionate and a nature lover. His thoughts are different from those around him, so he faces discrimination. His life takes a U-turn when he decides to leave his village with a friend dreaming to reopen a Beedi company.

credits.title: Aanandam Paramanandam
credits.overview: Anupama's alcoholic father dies by suicide with a masterplan. However, she must prosper in life for his soul to attain salvation

credits.title: Gold
credits.overview: On discovering a mysterious truck filled with illegal gold, a young man consumed with greed hatches an egotistical plan to use the treasure to his own advantage.

credits.title: Yugi
credits.overview: A detective, along with his team and with help of a suspended Police Sub-Inspector, goes in search of a missing girl, Karthika. What follows is shocking revelations about Karthika, who became the victim of power and economic exploitation.

credits.title: 1744 White Alto
credits.overview: Set in an unspecified place in Northern Kerala. Vijayan, a lowlife, gets himself involved in a case of mistaken identity. credits.title: Adrishyam
credits.overview: Revolves around the case of a missing girl (Anandhi), and there are too many people looking for her in parallel investigations. Nandakumar (Narain) and his team are on the lookout for her, as directed by a top police officer Purushothaman (Prathap Pothen) who cannot get directly involved with the case.

credits.title: Rorschach
credits.overview: When Luke Antony's wife goes missing, he sets off to search for her and stumbles upon the Balan family. However, terrorising events start occurring as Luke grows closer to them.

credits.title: Priyan Ottathilaanu
credits.overview: Dr. Priyadarshan, a middle class man, silently goes through the pangs of hyperactivity and ADHD that entangles him into a series of coincidental events. He then meets Priscilla, a feisty, constantly doubtful and depressed girl.

credits.title: Kochaal
credits.overview: A young man who aspires to become a police officer is mocked for his short stature and rejected. He becomes a constable after his father dies on duty but he still has to prove himself.

credits.title: Kuttavum Shikshayum
credits.overview: A five-member Kerala Police have to use their best policing skills when they go to Rajasthan to nab a gang behind a jewellery shop theft.

credits.title: Pathrosinte Padappukal
credits.overview: Pathrose is a gas agency employee whose family includes his wife and his four children. The central character in the film is his second son Tony, who lives happily without doing any work. The story revolves around Tony's grandmother who comes in between them and the interesting events that follow.

credits.title: Naradan
credits.overview: Chandraprakash, a well-known TV news anchor, comes under undue pressure from his higher-ups to bring competitive exclusives, which urges him to leave the job. When a rival media group offers him a new job, he rebrands himself into a loud, tyrannical journalist, catering to those looking for news theatrics.

credits.title: Aarkkariyam
credits.overview: Shirley and Roy in the middle of an impending Covid lock-down and a personal financial crisis, leave their Mumbai home for Shirley's home in Pala where her father Ittyavira stays. Roy soon finds that her home is not what he thought it is.

credits.title: Halal Love Story
credits.overview: A group of friends attempts to make a 'halal' film that conforms to the guidelines and descriptions of an Islamic organization which they are a part of.

credits.title: Anjaam Pathiraa
credits.overview: A psychologist with a keen interest in criminology gets entangled in a tough serial killer case which the police find hard to crack.

credits.title: Happy Sardar
credits.overview: Happy, a timid Sardar living in Patiala, finds his life turned upside down when he falls in love with Mary, a Malayali Knanaya Christian girl. His folks want a Punjabi wedding and Mary's father is adamant about having a Christian wedding.

credits.title: Virus
credits.overview: A real life account of the deadly Nipah virus outbreak in Kerala, and the courageous fight put on by several individuals which helped to contain the epidemic.

credits.title: Children's Park
credits.overview: 3 friends accidentally kidnapped 100 children from an orphanage.

credits.title: Neeyum Njanum
credits.overview: A newly married couple moves into a small town hoping to start a new life. But odds are against them and their life takes a roller coaster ride.

credits.title: Pretham 2
credits.overview: Five strangers who met online decide to shoot a short film in an old mansion but instead experience paranormal activity during their activities.

credits.title: Johny Johny Yes Appa
credits.overview: Johny pretends to be a gentleman but is a thief who thrives on lies and betrayals. His life turns upside down after his encounter with Adam, an orphan.

credits.title: Varathan
credits.overview: After losing his job, Aby and his wife, Priya, move back to the latter's family estate in Kerala. However, things go from bad to worse for the couple as they encounter a new set of challenges..

credits.title: Thobama
credits.overview: Three friends, thick as thieves, have glorious dreams for their future but adopt shortcuts in their pursuit. But fate seems to have something different in store for them.

credits.title: Aadhi
credits.overview: Aadhi, an aspiring musician, travels to another state in hopes of making it big. While there, an unexpected event leaves him trapped, unable to return to his family and running for his life.

credits.title: Carbon
credits.overview: Siby is unmindful of his duties towards his family, but is in the pursuit of making some easy money via various fraudulent means. To escape one of the troubles he courted, he goes on an assignment to an old palace in a forest-ridden Cheenkannippara, which has a never-before effect on him.

credits.title: Njandukalude Naattil Oridavela
credits.overview: Sheela Chacko's leads a regular life as a mother, wife and a college lecturer. All this turns around when she learns about a serious affliction facing her. The comedy-drama carries on about how her insecure husband and her three children react to the enfolding situation.

credits.title: Role Models
credits.overview: Gowtham is a geeky loner with hardly any social connections, though he was a jovial guy while at college. His parents, being worried about his extreme changes, attempt to bring back his old self with the help of Gowtham’s friends from college days.

credits.title: Georgettan's Pooram
credits.overview: George Vadakkan is the quintessential prodigal son of a priest, who wished he followed the father’s path. His friends and George generally hang out at Mathayi Parambu, a public playground cum hangout space of the area. How the park plays a part in setting his life straight is the core of the pooram.

credits.title: Munthirivallikal Thalirkkumbol
credits.overview: Panchayat Secretary Ullahanan leads a monotonous life till a college reunion rekindles excitement in his 20-year-old marital life and infuses in him a renewed sense of purpose and love for everything that he once took for granted.

credits.title: Welcome to Central Jail
credits.overview: Unnikuttan is a young man, who was born in the central jail. He considers jail as his second home. As a good Samaritan he takes on the punishments for petty crimes committed by others.

credits.title: Pretham
credits.overview: Three happy-go-lucky friends run a coastal resort till a series of mysterious events leave them worried. The plot thickens when a mentalist named John Don Bosco enters the fray to investigate the possibility of a paranormal entity.

credits.title: Happy Wedding
credits.overview: The story of an engineering graduate Hari, as he contemplates marriage on his mother's insistence.

credits.title: Pavada
credits.overview: Joy a young man who leads a carefree life. Joy acquaintance Babu Joseph, an English professor, and they reminiscence some seemingly forgotten memories.

credits.title: Premam
credits.overview: Three stages in George's life, and three girls he encounters in each stage.

credits.title: Homely Meals
credits.overview: "Homely Meals" is an entertainer starring Atlee Srindha Ashab, Manoj K. Jayan, Nedumudi Venu, Kailash, Sudheer Karamana, Joju, Neeraj Madhav and Sijoy Varghese in pivotal roles.

credits.title: Ohm Shanthi Oshaana
credits.overview: Pooja Mathew, a spirited young girl, wants to have a love marriage in her life. Thus, she stops at nothing to impress Giri, who saved her once from a group of unruly men.
Rameshan, who has great love for cricket, fails to become a cricketer in his life. However, he tries to fulfil his dreams through his son when he realises that the child too has a passion for it.

credits.title: Neram
credits.overview: Mathew is a graduate in software engineering, but is now jobless. He is waiting for his good time to get a good job. Mathew has borrowed some money as loan.
